title.value: Intervening With Confidence: Conformal Prescriptive Monitoring of Business Processes
title.justification: The title directly reflects the primary focus of the paper, which is the use of conformal prescriptive monitoring in business processes.
title.quote: Intervening With Confidence: Conformal Prescriptive Monitoring of Business Processes

extractions.description: The paper discusses a method to improve prescriptive process monitoring by incorporating conformal predictions, which provide confidence guarantees. The goal is to optimize interventions in business processes by ensuring interventions are executed with high confidence of success, thereby conserving limited resources. The method is empirically evaluated using public datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper revolves around optimizing business processes through machine learning techniques, specifically the use of conformal predictions for efficient resource allocation. There is no mention of direct applications to climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Prescriptive process monitoring methods seek to improve the performance of a process by selectively triggering interventions at runtime (e.g., offering a discount to a customer) to increase the probability of a desired case outcome (e.g., a customer making a purchase).
